Acquire KVM-backed or remote desktop concurrency before budgeted comparisons
Measure episode duration and invalid-environment rate before setting wall-clock expectations

reference_runs.purpose: same local evaluation protocol reference, not locally reproduced training

reference_runs.method: original GRPO + Frontier + visual context segmentation

research_pilot.initialization: fresh SFT per method and seed, never the full-pool RL checkpoint
research_pilot.selection: predeclare deterministic seed-group stratified subset from research train, no dev/test selection
research_pilot.task_sampling: fixed shared task sequence, Frontier off for all pilot arms; reintroduce Frontier as a separate factorial experiment
run_order: R3 only after R2 is stable
research_pilot.budget_semantics: 1024 is the planned number of consumed training episodes, not total environment work. Count retries, rejected episodes and async prefetch separately; cap and report actual environment decisions and GPU-hours for comparisons.

arms.method: unchanged GRPO estimator and original actor input / token loss reduction
mean-normalized environment-step temporal weights applied to original group-relative advantages
arms.control: same terminal reward, grouping, visual segmentation and actor prompt as R0
arms.label: temporal-weighting ablation inspired by TA-GRPO; not full Gamer reproduction
arms.implementation: Preserve rollout episode id and environment-step-to-output-token spans through visual compaction; do not weight observations or count copied context twice

arms.critic_inputs: exactly the actor-visible history up to the decision, including current screenshot; no future state
implementation: Predict one scalar value before each environment decision
Train explicit value head/network with value loss and record value explained variance
Map each step advantage to that decision output tokens; observation/context tokens remain masked
Apply terminal reward once per episode, across all compaction segments
True terminal outcomes and protocol-defined failed horizons have zero bootstrap; context-only truncation may bootstrap from valid next observation when episode continues
arms.resource_gate: Profile independent critic on 4 actor GPUs before choosing full tune versus LoRA; preserve that choice in all critic ablations

arms.method: critic with additional past history or recurrent memory
arms.control: same actor inputs as R2; compare to R2, not only critic-free GRPO
arms.restriction: past-only memory; no future observations, verifier labels or hidden task solution

dependencies: comparison groups sharing task and compaction stage
verifiable segment objective scores where available; otherwise sparse feedback
arms.restriction: Image eviction alone is not a local reward or an equivalent memory summary; do not silently reuse whole-trajectory terminal reward as newly verified per-segment progress
controls: Memory/compaction-only GRPO baseline with identical actor prompts
Same segment grouping and loss reduction with temporal beta=1
Temporal weighting with all other segment mechanics fixed

primary: task success by task and application
diagnostics: critic explained variance and value loss
reporting.statistics: paired task-level comparisons; bootstrap at base-task-group level, report seeds; keep development selection separate from final test
reporting.protocol_warning: Public RL seeds overlap official OSWorld benchmark. Research partition has seed-disjoint RL training, but SFT data exposure is not fully established.

sources.gamer_release_note: README marks Streaming-vLLM coming soon; no released TA-GRPO training implementation confirmed in the checked repository

paper_summary: Gamer compares segments by task and compaction stage, uses verified objective outcomes and critic-free group normalization, weights later decisions more heavily with mean-normalized beta powers, and averages losses over segments, steps, and output tokens. Its beta=0.9 is a starting point to test, not evidence of improvement on OSWorld.

implementation_observations.finding: Upstream flattens visual segments before compute_advantage. Each segment carries the terminal reward and the same group_id; group mean/std therefore count segment copies, not one reward per episode. The original behavior is preserved in R0.
implementation_observations.implication: Separate temporal-credit claims from segment-count and loss-reduction effects. Optional control: normalize once per episode uid and broadcast to its segments, changing nothing else.

implementation_observations.finding: repeat() assigns one group_id per prompt group and one uid per rollout. TaskManager propagates those fields into every segment; retain uid for reconstructing the environment-step timeline.
